Publisher PDF supplied by the curator (Neves-2014-Cellular scaling rul.pdf, this folder), Table 1 on PDF page 4, captured from the frozen PubMed Central full text (fulltext.html, PMC3925844) by Neves_etal_2014_Table1_snapshot.R (snapshot HOWTO method 2) and cross-checked cell by cell against the publisher PDF (text layer and rendered page): all 215 value cells and 43 row labels agree. The printed table is transposed (species as columns); the build transposes it. Counts printed in millions are converted to absolute numbers; mean +/- SD strings are split into mean and SD columns. One printed anomaly is handled in the build, guarded on the exact printed string: the Procavia capensis olfactory-bulb neuron count is printed inside typographic double quotes and is parsed as 20.909 million
